dct_description_sm: The CyanoTracker Network delivers continuous, high-frequency water quality data across the Wolastoq-Saint John River watershed, advancing real-time understanding of cyanobacteria dynamics and bloom risk. Led by the Hammond River Angling Association (HRAA) and powered by AquaRealTime technology, this open data network is made possible through major funding from the Canada Water Agency and the NB Environmental Trust Fund. Together, we are building one of the most robust community-driven cyanobacteria monitoring efforts in Atlantic Canada, turning data into early warning, transparency, and action.
